examples.en: The successful marketing campaign offered a ray of hope for the company's financial recovery.
examples.zh: 成功的行銷活動為公司的財務復甦提供了一線希望。

examples.en: Even in the toughest negotiations, she always maintains a ray of optimism.
examples.zh: 即使在最艱難的談判中，她總是保持著一絲樂觀。

examples.en: The manager's encouraging feedback brought a ray of light to the exhausted team.
examples.zh: 經理鼓舞人心的回饋為疲憊的團隊帶來了一線曙光。

examples.en: We are desperately looking for a ray of inspiration to finalize the design draft.
examples.zh: 我們正急切地尋找一絲靈感來完成設計草稿。

examples.en: A sudden ray of sunlight pierced through the office window, brightening the room.
examples.zh: 一線陽光突然穿透辦公室窗戶，照亮了房間。

examples.en: The delivery truck had to back slowly into the narrow alley behind the warehouse.
examples.zh: 送貨卡車必須緩慢地倒進倉庫後方狹窄的巷子裡。

examples.en: Many boutique cafes are tucked away in the quiet alleys of this historic district.
examples.zh: 許多精品咖啡館隱藏在這個歷史街區安靜的巷弄中。

examples.en: The supplier's rear entrance is located in an alley off the main boulevard.
examples.zh: 供應商的後門位於主幹道旁的一條小巷裡。

examples.en: Please ensure that no cardboard boxes block the fire alley.
examples.zh: 請確保沒有紙箱擋住防火巷。

examples.en: He parked his scooter in the alleyway to avoid paying the parking meter.
examples.zh: 他把機車停在巷子裡以避免繳停車費。

meaning: 醒著的；醒來；喚醒（用於比喻的意思）

examples.en: The constant ringing of the customer service phone kept the night shift staff awake.
examples.zh: 客服電話持續的響聲讓大夜班員工保持清醒。

examples.en: She was fully awake by the time the morning meeting started at 8 AM.
examples.zh: 在早上八點的晨會開始時，她已經完全清醒了。

examples.en: The sudden drop in our stock price should awake the board to the impending crisis.
examples.zh: 股價的突然下跌應該能喚醒董事會注意到即將來臨的危機。

examples.en: I usually drink a strong cup of espresso to stay awake during long presentations.
examples.zh: 我通常喝一杯濃縮咖啡以在冗長的簡報中保持清醒。

examples.en: The alarming financial report finally awoke the management from their complacency.
examples.zh: 令人擔憂的財務報告終於喚醒了管理層，讓他們不再自滿。

examples.en: The company finally awoke to the reality that their business model was outdated.
examples.zh: 公司終於醒悟到他們的商業模式已經過時的現實。

examples.en: It took several consumer complaints for them to awake to the product's flaws.
examples.zh: 在幾次消費者投訴後，他們才察覺到產品的瑕疵。

examples.en: We must awake to the fact that international competitors are entering our market.
examples.zh: 我們必須察覺到國際競爭對手正在進入我們市場的這個事實。

examples.en: The CEO has awoken to the urgent need for a digital transformation.
examples.zh: 執行長已經意識到數位轉型的迫切需求。

examples.en: Investors are slowly awaking to the potential risks of this aggressive expansion.
examples.zh: 投資者正慢慢察覺到這種激進擴張的潛在風險。

examples.en: The innovative proposal awakened a sense of creativity among the design team.
examples.zh: 這份創新的提案喚醒了設計團隊的創造力。

examples.en: I was awakened by an urgent call from my manager at dawn.
examples.zh: 我在黎明時分被經理的一通緊急電話喚醒。

examples.en: The new training program is designed to awaken the leadership potential in our staff.
examples.zh: 新的培訓計畫旨在喚醒員工的領導潛力。

examples.en: A loud fire alarm suddenly awakened everyone in the office building.
examples.zh: 響亮的火災警報突然喚醒了辦公大樓裡的所有人。

examples.en: This alarming market trend should awaken us to the necessity of change.
examples.zh: 這個令人擔憂的市場趨勢應該喚醒我們改變的必要性。

examples.en: The food processing plant uses strict sanitation measures to prevent bacteria growth.
examples.zh: 食品加工廠採用嚴格的衛生措施來防止細菌生長。

examples.en: Our laboratory is currently researching new ways to eliminate harmful bacteria in water.
examples.zh: 我們的實驗室目前正在研究消除水中極具危害之細菌的新方法。

examples.en: Some types of bacteria are actually beneficial to the human digestive system.
examples.zh: 某些種類的細菌實際上對人體消化系統是有益的。

examples.en: The antibacterial wipes are very effective at killing common office bacteria.
examples.zh: 抗菌濕巾能非常有效地殺死常見的辦公室細菌。

examples.en: Proper handwashing is the easiest way to stop the spread of bacteria in the workplace.
examples.zh: 正確洗手是阻止細菌在工作場所傳播的最簡單方法。

meaning: 餌；逗弄使某人生氣；引誘

examples.en: The retailer used a massive discount as bait to attract new customers.
examples.zh: 該零售商利用大幅折扣作為誘餌來吸引新顧客。

examples.en: He refused to take the bait when his competitor tried to provoke an argument.
examples.zh: 當競爭對手試圖挑起爭論時，他拒絕上鉤（不接受挑釁）。

examples.en: Scammers often send fake emails designed to bait users into revealing their passwords.
examples.zh: 詐騙者經常發送假電子郵件，旨在引誘用戶洩露密碼。

examples.en: The aggressive interviewer kept baiting the candidate with controversial questions.
examples.zh: 咄咄逼人的面試官不斷用具爭議性的問題逗弄、激怒求職者。

examples.en: They baited the trap with exclusive membership perks to secure more subscribers.
examples.zh: 他們用獨家會員福利作為誘餌，以確保獲得更多訂閱者。

examples.en: Managing this massive multinational project can sometimes feel like taming a wild beast.
examples.zh: 管理這個龐大的跨國專案有時感覺就像在馴服一頭野獸。

examples.en: The new supercomputer is an absolute beast when it comes to processing large datasets.
examples.zh: 在處理大型數據集方面，這台新的超級電腦絕對是一頭猛獸（形容性能強大）。

examples.en: He works like a beast to ensure all the department's quotas are met before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他像野獸般拚命工作，以確保在截止日期前達到部門的所有配額。

examples.en: The financial crisis unleashed a beast of inflation that was hard to control.
examples.zh: 金融危機釋放了一頭難以控制的通貨膨脹猛獸。

examples.en: Many folklore tales feature a mythical beast that guards the hidden treasure.
examples.zh: 許多民間傳說都有一頭守護隱藏寶藏的神話野獸。

examples.en: The local farm supplies fresh berries to several high-end restaurants in the city.
examples.zh: 當地農場為市內幾家高檔餐廳供應新鮮莓果。

examples.en: Our new beverage line features a refreshing mixed berry flavor.
examples.zh: 我們的新飲料系列主打清爽的綜合莓果口味。

examples.en: She added some berries to her morning oatmeal for a healthy breakfast before work.
examples.zh: 她在早上的燕麥片裡加了一些漿果，作為上班前的健康早餐。

examples.en: The agricultural report indicates that the berry harvest will be exceptionally good this year.
examples.zh: 農業報告指出，今年的莓果收成將會異常地好。

examples.en: We are designing a new packaging for our premium dried berry products.
examples.zh: 我們正在為我們的優質果乾產品設計新包裝。

examples.en: The bakery's signature blueberry muffins are always the first to sell out every morning.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店招牌的藍莓瑪芬每天早上總是第一個賣完。

examples.en: We import high-quality organic blueberries from Canada for our juice production.
examples.zh: 我們從加拿大進口高品質的有機藍莓用於果汁生產。

examples.en: The marketing team proposed a new blueberry-flavored energy drink to target younger consumers.
examples.zh: 行銷團隊提出了一款新的藍莓口味能量飲料，以吸引年輕消費者。

examples.en: A cup of fresh blueberries is rich in antioxidants and vitamins.
examples.zh: 一杯新鮮藍莓富含抗氧化劑和維生素。

examples.en: The catering service provided blueberry cheesecake as the dessert for the corporate event.
examples.zh: 外燴服務提供藍莓起司蛋糕作為公司活動的甜點。

examples.en: The driver had to slam on the brakes to avoid hitting the delivery cart.
examples.zh: 司機不得不猛踩煞車以避免撞上送貨推車。

examples.en: We need to put the brakes on our spending until the quarterly revenue improves.
examples.zh: 在季度營收改善之前，我們必須對開支踩煞車（控制開支）。

examples.en: The mechanic inspected the brake pads of the company vehicle during the routine maintenance.
examples.zh: 技工在例行保養期間檢查了公司車輛的煞車片。

examples.en: Rising interest rates have acted as a brake on the rapidly expanding housing market.
examples.zh: 不斷上升的利率對快速擴張的房地產市場起到了煞車（抑制）的作用。

examples.en: Make sure the parking brake is engaged before leaving the forklift.
examples.zh: 離開堆高機前，請確保已拉起停車煞車。

meaning: 嫩芽、花苞、蓓蕾；萌芽、開始發展

examples.en: The project is still in the bud, but it shows tremendous potential for the future.
examples.zh: 這個專案仍在萌芽階段，但它展現了巨大的未來潛力。

examples.en: We need to nip this customer service problem in the bud before it damages our reputation.
examples.zh: 我們必須將這個客服問題防患於未然（扼殺在萌芽狀態），以免損害我們的聲譽。

examples.en: The trees outside the office window are covered in spring buds.
examples.zh: 辦公室窗外的樹木佈滿了春天的嫩芽。

examples.en: Their partnership began to bud after a series of successful collaborative workshops.
examples.zh: 在幾次成功的合作工作坊之後，他們的夥伴關係開始萌芽發展。

examples.en: A new trend in sustainable fashion is budding among independent designers.
examples.zh: 一種永續時尚的新趨勢正在獨立設計師之間萌芽。

examples.en: The venture capital firm is looking to invest in budding technology startups.
examples.zh: 這家創投公司正尋求投資剛起步的科技新創企業。

examples.en: Our internship program aims to nurture budding talents in the software industry.
examples.zh: 我們的實習計畫旨在培育軟體產業中剛萌芽的人才。

examples.en: The manager praised the budding leadership skills of the junior executive.
examples.zh: 經理稱讚了這位初階主管剛萌芽的領導能力。

examples.en: Despite being a budding entrepreneur, she handled the tough negotiations like a professional.
examples.zh: 儘管是一位剛起步的創業家，她處理艱難談判的方式卻像個專業人士。

examples.en: We see a budding demand for eco-friendly packaging materials in the market.
examples.zh: 我們看到市場上對環保包裝材料剛萌芽的需求。

examples.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast buffet for all of its corporate guests.
examples.zh: 飯店為所有企業貴賓提供免費的自助早餐。

examples.en: We decided to host the annual company dinner at a luxurious seafood buffet restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們決定在一家豪華的海鮮自助餐廳舉辦公司尾牙。

examples.en: The buffet spread included a wide variety of international dishes to satisfy different tastes.
examples.zh: 自助餐的菜色包含了各種國際美食，以滿足不同的口味。

examples.en: The conference organizers arranged a lunchtime buffet to allow for networking.
examples.zh: 會議主辦方安排了午餐自助餐，以便與會者進行交流。

examples.en: Guests queued up at the buffet table to grab a slice of the famous roast beef.
examples.zh: 客人在自助餐檯前排隊，想拿一片著名的烤牛肉。

meaning: 撞擊；腫塊；路面的突起；撞到

examples.en: Sales saw a slight bump after we launched the holiday promotional campaign.
examples.zh: 在我們推出節日促銷活動後，銷售額出現了小幅增長（突起/提升）。

examples.en: The delivery driver hit a speed bump, causing some of the fragile packages to shake.
examples.zh: 送貨司機撞到了一個減速丘，導致一些易碎包裹搖晃。

examples.en: She accidentally bumped her head on the low ceiling of the storage room.
examples.zh: 她不小心在儲藏室低矮的天花板上撞到了頭。

examples.en: There might be a few bumps in the road as we transition to the new software system.
examples.zh: 在我們過渡到新軟體系統的過程中，可能會遇到一些小挫折（路上的突起）。

examples.en: He bumped the tray of coffee cups, spilling them all over the meeting table.
examples.zh: 他撞到了裝滿咖啡杯的托盤，把它們全灑在了會議桌上。

examples.en: I was surprised to bump into our former CEO at the industry conference in London.
examples.zh: 我很驚訝在倫敦的產業會議上不期而遇我們的前任執行長。

examples.en: While touring the factory floor, the inspector bumped into several safety hazards.
examples.zh: 在巡視工廠時，檢查員碰到了幾個安全隱患。

examples.en: She bumped into an old client who immediately asked for a new business proposal.
examples.zh: 她巧遇了一位老客戶，對方立刻要求提供一份新的商業提案。

examples.en: If you bump into the IT manager, please tell him my computer is still crashing.
examples.zh: 如果你碰到資訊經理，請告訴他我的電腦還在當機。

examples.en: We didn't expect to bump into such complicated legal issues during the merger.
examples.zh: 我們沒想到在合併過程中會碰到這麼複雜的法律問題。

meaning: (自助後計價的) 自助餐廳

examples.en: The newly renovated company cafeteria offers healthier meal options for employees.
examples.zh: 全新翻修的公司員工餐廳為員工提供更健康的餐點選擇。

examples.en: Let's discuss the project details over lunch in the cafeteria downstairs.
examples.zh: 我們去樓下的自助餐廳邊吃午餐邊討論專案細節吧。

examples.en: The hospital cafeteria is open 24 hours to serve both the medical staff and visitors.
examples.zh: 醫院的自助餐廳24小時營業，為醫護人員和訪客提供服務。

examples.en: Employees must scan their ID badges to pay for their meals at the cafeteria checkout.
examples.zh: 員工必須在自助餐廳結帳處掃描識別證來支付餐費。

examples.en: We hired a new catering company to improve the food quality in the student cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我們聘請了一家新的外燴公司來改善學生餐廳的食物品質。

examples.en: We hired a skilled carpenter to build custom wooden shelves for the new office.
examples.zh: 我們聘請了一位技術精湛的木匠為新辦公室打造客製化木製層架。

examples.en: The experienced carpenter carefully measured the dimensions before cutting the expensive oak wood.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的木匠在切割昂貴的橡木之前仔細測量了尺寸。

examples.en: Carpenters are in high demand right now due to the boom in housing construction.
examples.zh: 由於房屋建築的繁榮，目前對木匠的需求很高。

examples.en: The artisan furniture company employs dozens of master carpenters.
examples.zh: 這家手工家具公司雇用了數十名木匠大師。

examples.en: A good carpenter always ensures his tools are sharp and well-maintained.
examples.zh: 優秀的木匠總是確保他的工具鋒利且保養良好。

examples.en: The colleagues had a quick chat by the water cooler about the upcoming holiday.
examples.zh: 同事們在飲水機旁快速閒聊了一下即將到來的假期。

examples.en: Our customer support team provides real-time assistance through the live chat feature.
examples.zh: 我們的客服團隊透過線上即時聊天功能提供即時協助。

examples.en: Let's schedule a brief coffee chat tomorrow to discuss your career progression.
examples.zh: 我們明天安排一個短暫的咖啡閒談，討論你的職涯發展。

examples.en: She was chatting with a prospective client when the fire alarm unexpectedly went off.
examples.zh: 當火災警報意外響起時，她正在與一位潛在客戶聊天。

examples.en: The manager usually drops by my desk for a casual chat before the weekend begins.
examples.zh: 經理通常會在週末開始前順道來我的辦公桌旁隨意聊聊。

meaning: 使高興、鼓舞；歡呼、為～加油；喝采；乾杯 (敬酒時說的話)

examples.en: The unexpected year-end bonus really cheered up the entire sales department.
examples.zh: 意想不到的年終獎金真的鼓舞了整個業務部門。

examples.en: Employees cheered loudly when the CEO announced the successful acquisition.
examples.zh: 當執行長宣布成功收購時，員工們大聲歡呼。

examples.en: The manager bought coffee and donuts to cheer his team during the busy tax season.
examples.zh: 經理買了咖啡和甜甜圈，在繁忙的報稅季為他的團隊加油打氣。

examples.en: Let's raise our glasses and give a cheer to our retiring colleague, John.
examples.zh: 讓我們舉起酒杯，為即將退休的同事約翰乾杯/喝采。

examples.en: The crowd cheered the motivational speaker as she walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 當激勵人心的演講者走上舞台時，人群為她歡呼。

examples.en: The receptionist always greets incoming clients with a bright and cheerful smile.
examples.zh: 櫃檯接待員總是帶著明亮而愉快的微笑迎接進門的客戶。

examples.en: We painted the breakroom in cheerful colors to create a more relaxing environment.
examples.zh: 我們將休息室漆成了令人愉快的顏色，以創造一個更放鬆的環境。

examples.en: Despite the heavy workload, the team managed to maintain a cheerful attitude.
examples.zh: 儘管工作量很大，團隊仍設法保持愉快的態度。

examples.en: A cheerful work atmosphere can significantly boost overall employee productivity.
examples.zh: 愉快的職場氛圍能顯著提升整體員工的生產力。

examples.en: He sent a cheerful email to congratulate everyone on hitting the sales target.
examples.zh: 他發送了一封令人愉快的電子郵件，祝賀大家達到銷售目標。

meaning: 櫻桃；櫻桃口味的；櫻桃木的

examples.en: The newly installed conference table is made of solid cherry wood.
examples.zh: 新安裝的會議桌是由實心櫻桃木製成的。

examples.en: Our beverage company is launching a new cherry-flavored sparkling water next month.
examples.zh: 我們的飲料公司下個月將推出一款新的櫻桃口味氣泡水。

examples.en: The pastry chef carefully placed a single candied cherry on top of the dessert.
examples.zh: 糕點主廚小心翼翼地在甜點頂部放了一顆糖漬櫻桃。

examples.en: The agricultural export report showed a significant increase in cherry shipments this season.
examples.zh: 農業出口報告顯示本季櫻桃出貨量顯著增加。

examples.en: She enjoys snacking on fresh cherries while reading the morning financial news.
examples.zh: 她喜歡一邊吃新鮮櫻桃一邊閱讀早晨的財經新聞。

examples.en: The tourism board is promoting a travel package for the upcoming cherry blossom season.
examples.zh: 旅遊局正在推廣即將到來的櫻花季旅遊套裝行程。

examples.en: Many companies in Japan host outdoor parties under the blooming cherry blossoms.
examples.zh: 日本的許多公司會在盛開的櫻花樹下舉辦戶外派對。

examples.en: The cosmetic brand released a limited edition cherry blossom scented lotion.
examples.zh: 該化妝品品牌推出了一款限量版的櫻花香氛乳液。

examples.en: The park was crowded with photographers trying to capture the beautiful cherry blossoms.
examples.zh: 公園裡擠滿了試圖捕捉美麗櫻花畫面的攝影師。

examples.en: The delicate cherry blossoms signify the arrival of spring and new beginnings.
examples.zh: 嬌弱的櫻花象徵著春天的到來和新的開始。

examples.en: The upscale restaurant uses fine bone china to serve its VIP guests.
examples.zh: 這家高檔餐廳使用精緻的骨瓷來服務其VIP貴賓。

examples.en: She carefully packed the antique china into a padded box for the office relocation.
examples.zh: 她小心地將古董瓷器裝進有軟墊的盒子裡，以便辦公室搬遷。

examples.en: The department store is holding a clearance sale on imported china tableware.
examples.zh: 這家百貨公司正在舉辦進口瓷器餐具的清倉特賣。

examples.en: Please be careful when washing the delicate china cups in the pantry.
examples.zh: 在茶水間清洗易碎的瓷杯時請小心。

examples.en: The company presented a beautiful piece of decorative china as a retirement gift to the director.
examples.zh: 公司贈送了一件美麗的裝飾瓷器作為董事的退休禮物。

meaning: 渣、屑、碎片；晶片；薄片；切下或打掉一小片

examples.en: The global shortage of semiconductor chips has severely impacted automobile production.
examples.zh: 全球半導體晶片的短缺嚴重影響了汽車生產。

examples.en: She chipped her front tooth while trying to open the plastic packaging.
examples.zh: 她在試圖打開塑膠包裝時，把門牙磕掉了一小塊。

examples.en: The cafeteria is offering complimentary potato chips with every sandwich order.
examples.zh: 員工餐廳為每份三明治訂單提供免費的洋芋片（薄片）。

examples.en: The technician replaced the faulty memory chip in the server to restore the network.
examples.zh: 技術人員更換了伺服器中有缺陷的記憶體晶片以恢復網路。

examples.en: I noticed a small chip on the edge of the conference room's glass table.
examples.zh: 我注意到會議室玻璃桌邊緣有一小塊缺口（碎片/打掉的一小片）。

meaning: 劈、砍、剁（碎）；帶骨的肉排；砍、劈

examples.en: The management was forced to chop the marketing budget by 20% due to declining revenue.
examples.zh: 由於營收下降，管理層被迫大砍（削減）20%的行銷預算。

examples.en: The chef demonstrated how to quickly chop vegetables for the large banquet.
examples.zh: 主廚示範了如何為大型宴會快速切碎蔬菜。

examples.en: We ordered the grilled pork chops for the business lunch with the clients.
examples.zh: 我們為與客戶的商務午餐點了烤豬排。

examples.en: They had to chop down the old tree in front of the building to make way for the new parking lot.
examples.zh: 他們不得不砍掉大樓前的老樹，為新的停車場騰出空間。

examples.en: The restructuring plan will unfortunately chop several middle-management positions.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，重組計畫將砍掉幾個中階管理職位。

examples.en: Organizing the international trade show felt like managing a chaotic circus.
examples.zh: 組織這場國際貿易展感覺就像在管理一個混亂的馬戲團。

examples.en: The famous circus troupe is touring the country and generating massive ticket sales.
examples.zh: 著名的馬戲團正在全國巡演，並創造了龐大的票房收入。

examples.en: The media circus surrounding the celebrity CEO's resignation lasted for weeks.
examples.zh: 圍繞這位名人執行長辭職的媒體馬戲團（媒體亂象/大陣仗報導）持續了數週。

examples.en: Our company sponsored the local charity circus event to support underprivileged children.
examples.zh: 我們公司贊助了當地慈善馬戲團活動，以支持弱勢兒童。

examples.en: Don't turn this professional meeting into a circus by arguing over trivial details.
examples.zh: 不要為了瑣碎的細節爭吵，把這場專業會議變成一場鬧劇（馬戲團）。

examples.en: The company provides a free on-site health clinic for all its full-time employees.
examples.zh: 公司為所有全職員工提供免費的駐點健康診所。

examples.en: He took the afternoon off to visit the dental clinic for a routine check-up.
examples.zh: 他下午請假去牙科診所做例行檢查。

examples.en: The new software is designed to help medical clinics manage patient records more efficiently.
examples.zh: 這款新軟體旨在協助醫療診所更有效率地管理病患記錄。

examples.en: The famous tennis player hosted a weekend clinic to teach young athletes advanced techniques.
examples.zh: 這位著名的網球選手舉辦了一個週末臨床教學（訓練營），教導年輕運動員進階技巧。

examples.en: Our startup is developing an app that connects patients with nearby specialized clinics.
examples.zh: 我們的新創公司正在開發一款將病患與附近專科診所連接起來的應用程式。

examples.en: He is always clowning around in the office, which sometimes distracts his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他總是在辦公室裡扮小丑搞笑，有時會讓同事分心。

examples.en: The event planning agency hired a professional clown to entertain the guests' children.
examples.zh: 活動企劃公司聘請了一位專業小丑來娛樂賓客的孩子們。

examples.en: We can't afford to have a clown running the financial department during this crisis.
examples.zh: 在這場危機中，我們承擔不起讓一個小丑（不稱職、滑稽的人）來管理財務部門。

examples.en: Stop clowning and focus on finishing the quarterly report by 5 PM.
examples.zh: 別鬧了，專心在下午五點前完成季度報告。

examples.en: The CEO's clumsy handling of the PR disaster made him look like a complete clown.
examples.zh: 執行長對公關災難的笨拙處理讓他看起來完全像個小丑。

meaning: 持續的、經常的；恆定、永恆不變的事物；常數

examples.en: The server requires constant monitoring to ensure the website does not crash during peak hours.
examples.zh: 伺服器需要持續的監控，以確保網站在尖峰時段不會當機。

examples.en: Despite the fluctuating market, our commitment to high-quality customer service remains a constant.
examples.zh: 儘管市場波動，我們對高品質客戶服務的承諾依然是不變的恆定事物。

examples.en: Employees are complaining about the constant changes in the company's remote work policy.
examples.zh: 員工抱怨公司遠距工作政策的經常性變動。

examples.en: In this mathematical formula, 'k' represents a constant that adjusts the growth rate.
examples.zh: 在這個數學公式中，'k'代表一個調整增長率的常數。

examples.en: He lives under constant pressure to meet the unrealistic sales targets set by the board.
examples.zh: 他在為了達到董事會設定的不切實際的銷售目標的持續壓力下生活。

examples.en: The digital landscape is constantly evolving, requiring marketers to adapt quickly.
examples.zh: 數位領域正在持續地演進，要求行銷人員快速適應。

examples.en: She is constantly checking her email for updates on the pending contract.
examples.zh: 她經常查看電子郵件，以獲取有關待定合約的最新消息。

examples.en: Our competitors are constantly innovating their product lines to gain market share.
examples.zh: 我們的競爭對手不斷地創新其產品線以爭取市佔率。

examples.en: The machine must be constantly lubricated to prevent the internal gears from overheating.
examples.zh: 機器必須經常潤滑，以防止內部齒輪過熱。

examples.en: He complains constantly about the slow Wi-Fi speed in the conference room.
examples.zh: 他經常抱怨會議室裡緩慢的Wi-Fi速度。

meaning: 搖籃；溫柔地抱著；孕育地、發源地

examples.en: Silicon Valley is widely considered the cradle of modern technological innovation.
examples.zh: 矽谷被廣泛認為是現代科技創新的搖籃（發源地）。

examples.en: She carefully cradled the prototype device in her hands to prevent any damage.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地將原型設備溫柔地抱在手中，以防止任何損壞。

examples.en: The university has long been a cradle for outstanding engineers and scientists.
examples.zh: 這所大學長期以來一直是孕育傑出工程師和科學家的搖籃。

examples.en: He gently cradled the phone between his shoulder and ear while typing an email.
examples.zh: 他在打電子郵件時，將電話輕輕夾（抱）在肩膀和耳朵之間。

examples.en: The museum's new exhibition focuses on ancient civilizations from the cradle of humanity.
examples.zh: 博物館的新展覽聚焦於來自人類發源地的古代文明。

examples.en: Our beverage division launched a new line of cranberry juices infused with vitamins.
examples.zh: 我們的飲料部門推出了一系列富含維生素的新型蔓越莓果汁。

examples.en: The catering menu for the Thanksgiving corporate event included roasted turkey with cranberry sauce.
examples.zh: 感恩節企業活動的外燴菜單包括烤火雞佐蔓越莓醬。

examples.en: She added some dried cranberries to the salad to give it a slightly tart flavor.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉中加入了一些蔓越莓乾，使其帶有微酸的風味。

examples.en: The agricultural cooperative reported a successful harvest of cranberries this autumn.
examples.zh: 農業合作社報告今年秋天蔓越莓豐收。

examples.en: Many people drink cranberry extract as a dietary supplement for urinary tract health.
examples.zh: 許多人飲用蔓越莓萃取物作為泌尿道健康的營養補充品。

examples.en: The local dairy supplies fresh milk to all the coffee shops in the downtown area.
examples.zh: 當地的酪農場為市中心的所有咖啡館供應鮮奶。

examples.en: He manages a large commercial dairy that employs over fifty workers.
examples.zh: 他管理著一家擁有五十多名員工的大型商業酪農場。

examples.en: The supermarket is expanding its dairy section to accommodate more plant-based alternatives.
examples.zh: 超市正在擴大其乳製品區，以容納更多植物性替代品。

examples.en: We bought some artisan cheeses from a small dairy in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我們從鄉下的一家小乳製品販賣店買了一些手工起司。

examples.en: The government announced new subsidies to help struggling dairy farmers modernize their equipment.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了新的補貼方案，以幫助掙扎中的酪農現代化他們的設備。

examples.en: Due to a rise in lactose intolerance, sales of traditional dairy products have slightly declined.
examples.zh: 由於乳糖不耐症的增加，傳統乳製品的銷售額略有下降。

examples.en: The food company is investing heavily in developing lactose-free dairy products.
examples.zh: 該食品公司正投入大量資金開發無乳糖的乳製品。

examples.en: All imported dairy products must pass strict health and safety inspections at customs.
examples.zh: 所有進口乳製品都必須在海關通過嚴格的健康和安全檢查。

examples.en: We need to ensure that perishable dairy products are stored at the correct temperature during transit.
examples.zh: 我們必須確保易腐爛的乳製品在運輸過程中儲存於正確的溫度。

examples.en: Yogurt and cheese are among the most popular dairy products consumed globally.
examples.zh: 優格和起司是全球消費最受歡迎的乳製品之一。

examples.en: The government is funding the construction of a new dam to secure the region's water supply.
examples.zh: 政府正在資助新水壩的建設，以確保該地區的供水。

examples.en: Environmentalists argued that damming the river would negatively impact the local ecosystem.
examples.zh: 環保人士主張在河上築壩會對當地生態系統造成負面影響。

examples.en: She struggled to dam up her frustration during the difficult negotiation with the supplier.
examples.zh: 在與供應商的艱難談判中，她努力壓抑自己的挫折感。

examples.en: Before the rainy season, maintenance crews must thoroughly inspect the dam for any structural weaknesses.
examples.zh: 在雨季來臨前，維修人員必須徹底檢查水壩是否有任何結構上的弱點。

examples.en: The manager's patient tone helped to dam the rising panic among the team members.
examples.zh: 經理耐心的語氣有助於壓制團隊成員中不斷上升的恐慌情緒。

examples.en: The innovative startup has quickly become the darling of venture capitalists in Silicon Valley.
examples.zh: 這家創新的新創公司很快就成為矽谷創投家的寵兒。

examples.en: She bought a darling little dress for her niece's upcoming birthday party.
examples.zh: 她為姪女即將到來的生日派對買了一件迷人的小洋裝。

examples.en: "Could you review these financial reports for me, darling?" he asked his business partner affectionately.
examples.zh: 「親愛的，妳能幫我審查這些財務報告嗎？」他親切地問他的商業夥伴。

examples.en: Despite being an industry darling for years, the tech company recently faced a major PR crisis.
examples.zh: 儘管多年來一直是業界的寵兒，這家科技公司最近卻面臨了重大的公關危機。

examples.en: The CEO's new pet project is her absolute darling, receiving the majority of the research budget.
examples.zh: 執行長的新企劃是她的絕對心頭好，獲得了大部分的研究預算。

examples.en: The economic recession continues to deepen, causing widespread anxiety in the market.
examples.zh: 經濟衰退持續加深，在市場上引起了廣泛的焦慮。

examples.en: We aim to deepen our partnership with overseas distributors to expand our global reach.
examples.zh: 我們旨在加深與海外經銷商的合作夥伴關係，以擴展我們的全球版圖。

examples.en: As the investigation progressed, the mystery surrounding the missing funds only deepened.
examples.zh: 隨著調查的進展，圍繞著失蹤資金的謎團只會更加劇烈。

examples.en: Taking advanced training courses is a great way to deepen your professional knowledge.
examples.zh: 參加進階培訓課程是加深你專業知識的好方法。

examples.en: The company's commitment to sustainability will deepen its positive brand image.
examples.zh: 公司對永續發展的承諾將加深其正面的品牌形象。

examples.en: The candidate's impressive depth of knowledge in marketing strategy secured him the executive position.
examples.zh: 該候選人在行銷策略上令人印象深刻的知識深度，確保他獲得了這個高階職位。

examples.en: We need to analyze the consumer data in greater depth before launching the new product line.
examples.zh: 在推出新產品線之前，我們需要更深入地分析消費者數據。

examples.en: The submarine was designed to withstand extreme pressure at a depth of 3,000 meters.
examples.zh: 這艘潛水艇的設計能夠承受三千公尺深度下的極大壓力。

examples.en: Her novel explores the hidden depth of human emotions during times of crisis.
examples.zh: 她的小說探討了危機時期人類情感隱藏的深度。

examples.en: The investors were concerned about the sudden drop, but they underestimated the depth of the market's resilience.
examples.zh: 投資者對突然的下跌感到擔憂，但他們低估了市場韌性的深度。

examples.en: In today's competitive job market, experienced software engineers are not a dime a dozen.
examples.zh: 在當今競爭激烈的就業市場中，經驗豐富的軟體工程師並不是多如牛毛（不值錢）的。

examples.en: He refused to invest another dime in a project that had already shown signs of failure.
examples.zh: 他拒絕在一個已經顯示出失敗跡象的專案上再投資一毛錢。

examples.en: The automated vending machine in the lobby doesn't accept dimes or pennies.
examples.zh: 大廳裡的自動販賣機不接受一角或一分硬幣。

examples.en: She started her business without a dime and built it into a multimillion-dollar empire.
examples.zh: 她身無分文地創業，並將其建立為一個價值數百萬美元的帝國。

examples.en: The consultant claimed he could increase our profits, but we haven't seen a dime of improvement yet.
examples.zh: 顧問聲稱他能增加我們的利潤，但我們還沒有看到一絲一毫的改善。

examples.en: Sales of winter apparel usually dip significantly during the summer months.
examples.zh: 冬季服飾的銷售量在夏季通常會大幅下降。

examples.en: She briefly dipped the document into the water-resistant coating to protect it.
examples.zh: 她短暫地將文件浸入防水塗層中以保護它。

examples.en: We recommend serving these crispy appetizers with a spicy cheese dip.
examples.zh: 我們建議將這些酥脆的開胃菜搭配辛辣的起司沾醬一起食用。

examples.en: The stock market experienced a slight dip yesterday, but recovered quickly by closing time.
examples.zh: 股市昨天經歷了輕微的下跌，但在收盤前迅速回升。

examples.en: Let's dip into our contingency fund to cover these unexpected maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 我們動用應急基金來支付這些預期外的維修費用吧。

examples.en: The company decided to ditch its outdated software system in favor of a modern cloud-based solution.
examples.zh: 公司決定拋棄其過時的軟體系統，轉而使用現代的雲端解決方案。

examples.en: Heavy rain flooded the drainage ditch along the edge of the construction site.
examples.zh: 大雨淹沒了建築工地邊緣的排水溝。

examples.en: After realizing the marketing campaign was ineffective, they ditched it completely.
examples.zh: 在意識到行銷活動無效後，他們徹底甩掉了這個計畫。

examples.en: The driver lost control of the delivery truck, and it ended up in a muddy ditch.
examples.zh: 司機失去了對送貨卡車的控制，結果車子掉進了泥濘的溝渠裡。

examples.en: He had to ditch his original presentation and improvise when the projector stopped working.
examples.zh: 當投影機故障時，他不得不放棄原來的簡報並即興發揮。

examples.en: The cargo ship is scheduled to dock at terminal 4 early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 貨船預計於明早清晨停靠在第四航廈碼頭。

examples.en: Workers at the dock were busy loading containers onto the massive freight vessels.
examples.zh: 碼頭上的工人正忙著將貨櫃裝載到巨大的貨輪上。

examples.en: Employees who consistently arrive late will have their pay docked as a penalty.
examples.zh: 經常遲到的員工將會被扣薪作為懲罰。

examples.en: The ferry approached the wooden dock slowly to ensure the safety of the passengers.
examples.zh: 渡輪緩慢地靠近木製碼頭，以確保乘客的安全。

examples.en: Once the space shuttle docks with the international space station, the astronauts can begin transferring supplies.
examples.zh: 一旦太空梭與國際太空站對接，太空人就可以開始轉移物資。

examples.en: The persistent overtime work has completely drained the marketing team of their creativity.
examples.zh: 持續的加班已經完全消耗掉行銷團隊的創造力。

examples.en: Please make sure to drain the water from the coffee machine before conducting any repairs.
examples.zh: 在進行任何維修之前，請務必排乾咖啡機裡的水。

examples.en: The severe economic crisis proved to be a massive drain on the country's financial reserves.
examples.zh: 嚴重的經濟危機被證明對該國的財政儲備造成了巨大的消耗。

examples.en: A blocked drain in the employee cafeteria caused a minor flood yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午，員工餐廳的排水管堵塞導致了輕微的淹水。

examples.en: You must wash the fresh produce thoroughly and let it drain before packing.
examples.zh: 你必須徹底清洗新鮮農產品，並讓其流乾水分後再包裝。

examples.en: It is strictly illegal for factories to dump hazardous chemical waste into the nearby river.
examples.zh: 工廠將有害化學廢棄物傾倒至附近河流是嚴格違法的。

examples.en: The tech firm decided to dump its underperforming product lines to focus on core business.
examples.zh: 這家科技公司決定甩掉表現不佳的產品線，專注於核心業務。

examples.en: The city council is seeking a new location for the municipal waste dump.
examples.zh: 市議會正在為市立垃圾場尋找新的地點。

examples.en: Investors rushed to dump their shares following the scandal involving the CEO.
examples.zh: 在涉及執行長的醜聞爆發後，投資者爭相拋售他們的股票。

examples.en: I can't believe he would just dump all this extra paperwork on my desk without asking.
examples.zh: 我不敢相信他居然沒問一聲就把所有這些額外的文書工作丟在我的桌上。

examples.en: Her seamless presentation skills were the envy of all her colleagues in the sales department.
examples.zh: 她流暢的簡報技巧是業務部所有同事羨慕的對象。

examples.en: Many small businesses envy the massive marketing budget of multinational corporations.
examples.zh: 許多小型企業嫉妒跨國公司龐大的行銷預算。

examples.en: He couldn't hide his envy when his coworker received the promotion they had both applied for.
examples.zh: 當他的同事獲得他們兩人都申請的晉升時，他無法掩飾自己的嫉妒。

examples.en: The new luxury resort boasts facilities that will make rival hotels green with envy.
examples.zh: 這家新的豪華度假村擁有會讓競爭飯店眼紅（羨慕）的設施。

examples.en: I don't envy the manager who has to announce the upcoming round of layoffs.
examples.zh: 我一點也不羨慕那位必須宣布即將到來的一輪裁員的經理。

examples.en: If we don't secure this contract, all our hard work over the past six months will go down the drain.
examples.zh: 如果我們沒有拿下這份合約，過去六個月的所有努力都將付諸流水。

examples.en: The startup went bankrupt, and the investors saw millions of dollars go down the drain.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司破產了，投資者眼睜睜看著數百萬美元白費。

examples.en: She felt frustrated that her efforts to mediate the dispute just went down the drain.
examples.zh: 她感到很沮喪，因為她調解爭端的努力全都付諸流水。

examples.en: Without a proper backup strategy, years of valuable research data could go down the drain during a system crash.
examples.zh: 如果沒有適當的備份策略，多年的寶貴研究數據可能會在系統崩潰時付諸流水。

examples.en: I refuse to let this golden opportunity go down the drain because of a minor administrative error.
examples.zh: 我拒絕讓這個千載難逢的機會因為一個小小的行政錯誤而白費。

examples.en: The HR department issued a reminder that spreading malicious office gossip is against company policy.
examples.zh: 人力資源部發布提醒，散播惡意的辦公室八卦違反公司政策。

examples.en: He spent the entire lunch break gossiping about the upcoming management restructuring.
examples.zh: 他整個午休時間都在閒聊即將到來的管理層重組。

examples.en: Don't believe every piece of gossip you hear concerning the merger with our competitor.
examples.zh: 不要相信你聽到的關於我們與競爭對手合併的每一則閒聊是非。

examples.en: The tabloid magazine is famous for publishing unverified gossip about well-known entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 這家小報雜誌以出版關於知名企業家未經證實的八卦而聞名。

examples.en: They often gather by the water cooler to gossip, which occasionally affects their productivity.
examples.zh: 他們經常聚集在飲水機旁閒聊，這偶爾會影響他們的生產力。

meaning: 港口；避風港；懷有(想法等)

examples.en: The natural harbor provides excellent protection for cargo ships during severe storms.
examples.zh: 這個天然港口在強烈風暴期間為貨船提供了絕佳的保護。

examples.en: Despite his polite demeanor, he harbors a deep resentment towards his former business partner.
examples.zh: 儘管他舉止有禮，但他對前任商業夥伴懷有深深的怨恨。

examples.en: The coastal city heavily relies on the bustling harbor for its economic development.
examples.zh: 這座沿海城市嚴重依賴繁華的港口來發展其經濟。

examples.en: It is unwise to harbor unrealistic expectations about the initial returns of this risky investment.
examples.zh: 對這項高風險投資的初期回報心懷不切實際的期望是不明智的。

examples.en: The old warehouse near the harbor has been renovated into a trendy commercial space.
examples.zh: 靠近港口的舊倉庫已被翻新成時尚的商業空間。

examples.en: The cherry trees along the avenue are already in bud, signaling the arrival of early spring.
examples.zh: 大道兩旁的櫻花樹已經含苞待放，預告著早春的到來。

examples.en: The project was still in bud when the board decided to withdraw the essential funding.
examples.zh: 這項計畫還在萌芽階段，董事會就決定撤回必要的資金。

examples.en: Our new marketing concept is currently in bud and needs more brainstorming to fully develop.
examples.zh: 我們的新行銷概念目前還處於萌芽期，需要更多腦力激盪來全面發展。

examples.en: Walking through the botanical garden, we noticed that many exotic plants were in bud.
examples.zh: 漫步在植物園裡，我們注意到許多異國植物都含苞待放。

examples.en: The startup's promising technology was in bud, attracting the attention of several angel investors.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司前景看好的技術正處於萌芽階段，吸引了幾位天使投資人的目光。

examples.en: The software engineer managed to invent a revolutionary algorithm that drastically reduces processing time.
examples.zh: 這位軟體工程師成功發明了一種革命性的演算法，能大幅減少處理時間。

examples.en: When questioned about his absence, the employee invented a complex excuse that no one believed.
examples.zh: 當被問及缺席原因時，該員工編造（發明）了一個沒有人相信的複雜藉口。

examples.en: Necessity often drives businesses to invent novel solutions to overcome unprecedented challenges.
examples.zh: 需求往往驅使企業發明新奇的解決方案，以克服前所未有的挑戰。

examples.en: The laboratory was established specifically to invent environmentally friendly alternative materials.
examples.zh: 建立這個實驗室是專門為了發明環保的替代材料。

examples.en: She hopes to invent a household device that can make daily chores much more efficient.
examples.zh: 她希望能發明一種可以讓日常家務變得更有效率的家用設備。

examples.en: The brilliant inventor holds over fifty patents in the field of renewable energy technology.
examples.zh: 這位才華橫溢的發明家在再生能源技術領域擁有五十多項專利。

examples.en: Many people don't know the name of the inventor behind this widely used office gadget.
examples.zh: 許多人不知道這個廣泛使用的辦公室小工具背後發明家的名字。

examples.en: As an independent inventor, securing adequate funding for prototypes is his biggest hurdle.
examples.zh: 身為一名獨立發明家，為原型機獲得足夠的資金是他最大的障礙。

examples.en: The renowned inventor was invited to give a keynote speech at the international tech conference.
examples.zh: 這位著名的發明家受邀在國際科技會議上發表主題演講。

examples.en: It took the inventor several years of trial and error before perfecting the final design.
examples.zh: 這位發明家花了幾年的時間反覆試驗，才完善了最終的設計。

examples.en: The local artisan sells homemade organic jam packed in beautifully decorated glass jars.
examples.zh: 當地工匠販售裝在裝飾精美的玻璃廣口瓶中的自製有機果醬。

examples.en: Every time he heard the sudden, loud noise, it would heavily jar his nerves.
examples.zh: 每次他聽到那突如其來的巨大噪音，都會強烈地刺激（震動）他的神經。

examples.en: Please ensure that the lid of the chemical jar is tightly sealed before storing it.
examples.zh: 在儲存之前，請確保化學品罐子的蓋子已緊緊密封。

examples.en: She dropped a heavy coin into the tip jar placed on the cafe counter.
examples.zh: 她把一枚沉甸甸的硬幣投入了放在咖啡廳櫃檯上的小費罐中。

examples.en: The CEO's informal attire struck a jarring contrast with the strictly formal boardroom environment.
examples.zh: 執行長非正式的服裝與極度正式的會議室環境形成了令人不快（不和諧）的對比。

examples.en: The logistics company requested drivers to use the designated truck lane to expedite deliveries.
examples.zh: 這家物流公司要求司機使用指定的卡車車道以加快送貨速度。

examples.en: The city government plans to add a bicycle lane to reduce traffic congestion downtown.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫增加一條自行車道，以減少市中心的交通壅塞。

examples.en: He opened a quaint little coffee shop tucked away in a quiet residential lane.
examples.zh: 他在一條安靜的住宅巷子裡開了一家古雅的小咖啡館。

examples.en: The highway patrol stopped the speeding vehicle for frequently changing lanes without signaling.
examples.zh: 高速公路巡警攔下了那輛因頻繁變換車道且未打方向燈而超速的車輛。

examples.en: Life in the fast lane of corporate finance eventually took a toll on her health.
examples.zh: 企業金融界快節奏（快車道）的生活最終損害了她的健康。

examples.en: The farm produces a highly sought-after organic mulberry jam that sells out quickly online.
examples.zh: 這座農場生產一種備受追捧的有機桑葚果醬，在網路上很快就銷售一空。

examples.en: She decided to plant a mulberry tree in her backyard to attract more birds to the garden.
examples.zh: 她決定在後院種一棵桑樹，以吸引更多鳥類來到花園。

examples.en: Our new cosmetic product line features antioxidants extracted from mulberry leaves.
examples.zh: 我們的新化妝品系列主打從桑葉中提取的抗氧化劑。

examples.en: He stained his white shirt while enthusiastically harvesting fresh mulberries at the orchard.
examples.zh: 他在果園熱情地採摘新鮮桑葚時，弄髒了他的白襯衫。

examples.en: Historically, mulberry cultivation was essential for the thriving local silk industry.
examples.zh: 在歷史上，桑樹的種植對於當地繁榮的絲綢工業至關重要。

examples.en: The research team proposed a completely novel approach to resolving the supply chain bottlenecks.
examples.zh: 研究團隊提出了一種完全新奇的方法來解決供應鏈的瓶頸。

examples.en: His latest novel about corporate espionage has topped the bestseller list for three consecutive weeks.
examples.zh: 他最新一本關於商業間諜的小說已經連續三週高居暢銷書排行榜榜首。

examples.en: Using social media influencers as the primary marketing channel was a novel idea at the time.
examples.zh: 在當時，利用社群媒體網紅作為主要行銷管道是一個新奇的想法。

examples.en: The startup's novel app design immediately caught the attention of prominent industry reviewers.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司新奇的應用程式設計立刻引起了知名業界評論家的注意。

examples.en: She spent her vacation reading a fascinating science fiction novel by her favorite author.
examples.zh: 她利用假期閱讀了她最喜歡的作家所寫的一本引人入勝的科幻小說。

examples.en: The renowned novelist will be hosting a book signing event at the central library this weekend.
examples.zh: 這位著名的小說家本週末將在中央圖書館舉辦新書簽名會。

examples.en: Aspiring to become a successful novelist, he dedicates at least three hours every evening to writing.
examples.zh: 立志成為一名成功的小說家，他每天晚上至少投入三個小時寫作。

examples.en: The award-winning novelist is known for incorporating complex economic themes into his fiction.
examples.zh: 這位屢獲殊榮的小說家以將複雜的經濟主題融入他的小說中而聞名。

examples.en: Our publishing house just signed a promising young novelist who specializes in historical thrillers.
examples.zh: 我們的出版社剛剛簽下了一位專攻歷史驚悚小說、極具潛力的年輕小說家。

examples.en: Before working as an advertising copywriter, she tried making a living as a freelance novelist.
examples.zh: 在擔任廣告文案之前，她曾嘗試以自由小說家的身分謀生。

examples.en: Once the novelty of the new office layout wears off, employees usually return to their old habits.
examples.zh: 一旦新辦公室佈局的新鮮感消退，員工通常會恢復他們以前的習慣。

examples.en: The tech exhibition showcased several novelty items that were more entertaining than practical.
examples.zh: 這場科技展覽展示了幾款娛樂性大於實用性的新奇事物。

examples.en: Working remotely was a novelty at first, but it quickly became the standard operating procedure.
examples.zh: 遠距工作起初是個新奇的事物，但很快就成為了標準作業程序。

examples.en: Tourist shops near the landmark often sell inexpensive novelty souvenirs to passing visitors.
examples.zh: 地標附近的旅遊商店經常向路過的遊客出售廉價的新奇紀念品。

examples.en: The marketing team hopes the novelty of the interactive packaging will boost product sales.
examples.zh: 行銷團隊希望互動式包裝的新奇感能促進產品銷售。

examples.en: He promised that producing the updated software wouldn't cost the clients a single penny more.
examples.zh: 他保證製作更新的軟體不會讓客戶多花一分錢。

examples.en: You should check your financial statements closely to ensure every penny is accounted for.
examples.zh: 您應該仔細檢查您的財務報表，以確保每一分錢都有清楚的紀錄。

examples.en: She pinched every penny in her budget to afford the expensive certification course.
examples.zh: 她在預算上精打細算（省吃儉用每一分錢），以便負擔得起昂貴的認證課程。

examples.en: The antique dealer told him that the rare coin he found wasn't worth a penny.
examples.zh: 古董商告訴他，他找到的那枚罕見硬幣一文不值（不值一分錢）。

examples.en: The charity organization is incredibly transparent about how they spend every penny donated to them.
examples.zh: 這家慈善機構對他們如何花費捐贈給他們的每一分錢都非常透明。

examples.en: The museum recently acquired a priceless collection of antique porcelain from the Ming Dynasty.
examples.zh: 博物館最近收購了一批價值連城的明代古董瓷器收藏品。

examples.en: We recommend hand-washing these delicate porcelain teacups rather than using a dishwasher.
examples.zh: 我們建議手洗這些精緻的瓷器茶杯，而不是使用洗碗機。

examples.en: The high-end restaurant serves its signature dishes on exclusively designed porcelain plates.
examples.zh: 這家高檔餐廳使用獨家設計的瓷盤來盛裝其招牌菜。

examples.en: She started a small business importing fine porcelain ceramics directly from European artisans.
examples.zh: 她創辦了一家直接從歐洲工匠那裡進口精美瓷器陶瓷的小公司。

examples.en: The floor of the luxury hotel lobby was beautifully tiled with highly polished porcelain.
examples.zh: 這家豪華酒店大廳的地板鋪設了拋光精美的瓷磚。

examples.en: The government decided to pour millions of dollars into developing renewable energy infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府決定投入數百萬美元來發展再生能源基礎設施。

examples.en: Could you please pour me another cup of coffee before the morning briefing begins?
examples.zh: 在早晨簡報開始前，能請你再幫我倒一杯咖啡嗎？

examples.en: Customer complaints began to pour in shortly after the flawed software update was released.
examples.zh: 在有缺陷的軟體更新發布後不久，客戶的投訴就開始大量湧入。

examples.en: We had to cancel the outdoor team-building event because it started to pour down rain.
examples.zh: 因為開始下傾盆大雨，我們不得不取消戶外團隊建立活動。

examples.en: He is willing to pour all his energy and time into making this ambitious project a success.
examples.zh: 他願意傾注所有的精力和時間，讓這個雄心勃勃的專案取得成功。

meaning: 四分之一；兩角五分硬幣；季度

examples.en: The corporation reported a significant increase in net profit for the third fiscal quarter.
examples.zh: 該公司報告指出第三會計季度的淨利潤有顯著的增長。

examples.en: Roughly a quarter of our total revenue comes from international sales operations.
examples.zh: 我們總收入中大約有四分之一來自國際銷售業務。

examples.en: The parking meter strictly requires quarters if you want to park your car here for an hour.
examples.zh: 如果你想在這裡停車一小時，這台停車收費表嚴格要求投入二十五分錢的硬幣。

examples.en: We still have a quarter of an hour left before the video conference officially starts.
examples.zh: 距離視訊會議正式開始，我們還有一刻鐘（十五分鐘）的時間。

examples.en: In the historic quarter of the city, many traditional craft shops continue to operate.
examples.zh: 在這個城市的歷史街區（四分之一區域），許多傳統手工藝品店仍在營運。

examples.en: The bakery's most popular pastry features a rich dark chocolate filling and fresh raspberry sauce.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店最受歡迎的糕點特色是濃郁的黑巧克力餡和新鮮的覆盆子醬。

examples.en: She ordered an iced raspberry tea to cool down after the stressful board meeting.
examples.zh: 在壓力沉重的董事會會議後，她點了一杯冰覆盆子茶來降溫。

examples.en: The agricultural sector noted a decline in raspberry yields due to unseasonably warm weather.
examples.zh: 農業部門注意到，由於反常的溫暖天氣，覆盆子的產量有所下降。

examples.en: For dessert, the catering service provided miniature cheesecakes topped with a single raspberry.
examples.zh: 作為甜點，外燴服務提供點綴著一顆覆盆子的迷你起司蛋糕。

examples.en: Our new lip balm product comes in three exciting flavors: mint, vanilla, and raspberry.
examples.zh: 我們的新護唇膏產品有三種令人興奮的口味：薄荷、香草和覆盆子。

examples.en: The sudden increase in quarterly sales provided a ray of hope for the struggling retail company.
examples.zh: 季度銷售額的突然增長，為這家陷入困境的零售公司提供了一線（光線）希望。

examples.en: prolonged exposure to ultraviolet rays without protection can cause severe damage to the skin.
examples.zh: 在沒有防護的情況下長時間暴露於紫外線光線中，會對皮膚造成嚴重的傷害。

examples.en: Through the thick clouds, a single ray of sunlight illuminated the ancient monument.
examples.zh: 穿過厚厚的雲層，一道陽光照亮了這座古老的紀念碑。

examples.en: The medical researchers are developing new treatments using targeted X-rays to destroy tumor cells.
examples.zh: 醫學研究人員正在開發使用標靶 X 光線來摧毀腫瘤細胞的新療法。

examples.en: The newly elected mayor is seen as a ray of sunshine in an otherwise bleak political landscape.
examples.zh: 新當選的市長被視為原本黯淡政治版圖中的一線陽光。

examples.en: The widespread power outage caused all the perishable food in the supermarket freezers to spoil.
examples.zh: 大規模的停電導致超市冷凍庫裡所有易腐壞的食物都壞掉了。

examples.en: I don't want to spoil the surprise, so I won't tell you the details of the farewell party.
examples.zh: 我不想破壞驚喜，所以我不會告訴你歡送派對的細節。

examples.en: Grandparents have a notorious reputation for wanting to spoil their grandchildren with gifts.
examples.zh: 祖父母因喜歡用禮物溺愛孫輩而出了名。

examples.en: A minor miscalculation in the spreadsheet threatened to spoil the entire financial forecast.
examples.zh: 電子表格中一個微小的計算錯誤差點破壞了整個財務預測。

examples.en: The constant pampering from his wealthy parents threatened to spoil his work ethic completely.
examples.zh: 他富裕父母不斷的嬌慣差點完全破壞了他的職業道德（讓他被寵壞）。

meaning: 被溺愛的；被破壞的(spoil的過去式/過去分詞)

examples.en: Many critics dismissed the heir as a spoilt child who had never worked a day in his life.
examples.zh: 許多評論家將這位繼承人視為一個被寵壞的孩子，他這輩子從未工作過一天。

examples.en: The picnic was completely spoilt by the sudden and relentless afternoon thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 野餐完全被突然且無情的午後雷陣雨給破壞了。

examples.en: She realized too late that the milk she used in the recipe was spoilt.
examples.zh: 她太晚才意識到她在食譜中使用的牛奶已經壞了。

examples.en: He acts like a spoilt brat whenever the manager rejects his unrealistic project proposals.
examples.zh: 每當經理拒絕他不切實際的專案提案時，他的行為就像個被寵壞的屁孩。

examples.en: The picturesque landscape was spoilt by the construction of an ugly industrial facility.
examples.zh: 如畫的風景被一座醜陋工業設施的建設給破壞了。

examples.en: The negotiation team must stick to their initial demands regarding the pricing structure.
examples.zh: 談判團隊必須堅持他們對定價結構的最初要求。

examples.en: I tried to stick the notification on the bulletin board, but the tape wasn't strong enough.
examples.zh: 我試圖把通知黏貼在佈告欄上，但膠帶不夠黏。

examples.en: The printer suddenly broke down because a large piece of paper got stuck in the roller.
examples.zh: 印表機突然故障，因為一大張紙卡在滾筒裡了。

examples.en: We were stuck in heavy traffic for two hours and ultimately missed the important flight.
examples.zh: 我們在擁擠的交通中陷入車陣兩個小時，最終錯過了那班重要的航班。

examples.en: He used a long wooden stick to gently push the fallen debris out of the drainage pipe.
examples.zh: 他用一根長木棍輕輕地將掉落的碎屑推出排水管。

examples.en: All employees must display a valid parking sticker on their vehicles to access the company garage.
examples.zh: 所有員工必須在車輛上展示有效的停車貼紙，才能進入公司車庫。

examples.en: The retail store put a bright yellow discount sticker on all items scheduled for clearance.
examples.zh: 這家零售店在所有準備清倉的商品上貼上了鮮黃色的折扣貼紙。

examples.en: She often uses animated stickers in the messaging app to express her emotions during conversations.
examples.zh: 她經常在即時通訊應用程式中使用動態貼圖，在對話中表達她的情緒。

examples.en: The price sticker was stubbornly glued to the bottom of the glass, making it hard to remove.
examples.zh: 價格貼紙死死地黏在玻璃杯底部，很難撕下來。

examples.en: The campaign organizers handed out bumper stickers to supporters to raise awareness for the cause.
examples.zh: 活動組織者向支持者分發保險桿貼紙，以提高人們對該事業的認識。

examples.en: The spilled syrup left a sticky residue on the conference room table that was hard to clean.
examples.zh: 灑出的糖漿在會議室桌子上留下了難以清理的黏稠殘留物。

examples.en: The public relations manager had to carefully navigate a very sticky situation during the press briefing.
examples.zh: 公關經理在新聞發布會上必須小心翼翼地處理一個非常棘手（黏人）的局面。

examples.en: This particular brand of tape isn't sticky enough to securely seal the heavy shipping boxes.
examples.zh: 這個特定品牌的膠帶不夠黏，無法牢固地密封沉重的運輸箱。

examples.en: The weather in this tropical region is typically hot and extremely sticky during the summer months.
examples.zh: 這個熱帶地區的夏天天氣通常很熱且極度悶熱（黏膩）。

examples.en: Make sure to wash your hands immediately after using that incredibly sticky industrial glue.
examples.zh: 使用那種極度黏稠的工業膠水後，請務必立即洗手。

examples.en: The local farm allows visitors to pick fresh strawberries during the peak harvest season.
examples.zh: 當地農場允許遊客在收穫旺季採摘新鮮草莓。

examples.en: The company introduced a new strawberry-flavored beverage to appeal to younger consumers.
examples.zh: 公司推出了一款新的草莓口味飲料，以吸引年輕消費者。

examples.en: She decorated the elaborate wedding cake with edible gold flakes and sliced strawberries.
examples.zh: 她用可食用的金箔和切片的草莓裝飾這個精美的結婚蛋糕。

examples.en: The artificial strawberry aroma in this cosmetic product is surprisingly pleasant and not overpowering.
examples.zh: 這款化妝品中的人造草莓香氣出人意料地宜人，而且不會太刺鼻。

examples.en: Due to a poor harvest, the market price for organic strawberries has skyrocketed this month.
examples.zh: 由於收成不佳，有機草莓的市場價格本月飆升。

examples.en: Please move your stuff off the desk so we can set up the projector for the presentation.
examples.zh: 請把你的東西從桌上移開，以便我們架設簡報用的投影機。

examples.en: The warehouse is full of promotional stuff that needs to be distributed by next week.
examples.zh: 倉庫裡堆滿了宣傳物品，必須在下週前分發完畢。

examples.en: Before finalizing the report, make sure you double-check all the financial stuff.
examples.zh: 在完成報告之前，請務必仔細檢查所有的財務資料。

examples.en: The workers are busy stuffing envelopes with brochures for the upcoming marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 員工們正忙著將小冊子裝進信封裡，為即將到來的行銷活動做準備。

examples.en: He hurriedly stuffed the important documents into his briefcase and rushed to the airport.
examples.zh: 他匆忙地將重要文件塞進公事包裡，然後趕往機場。

examples.en: The suggestion box was completely stuffed with complaints from dissatisfied customers.
examples.zh: 意見箱裡塞滿了不滿意顧客的投訴信。

examples.en: After the holiday sale, our inventory room was no longer stuffed to maximum capacity.
examples.zh: 節日促銷過後，我們的庫存室不再是塞到滿載的狀態。

examples.en: The overhead compartments on the flight were so stuffed that I had to check my carry-on bag.
examples.zh: 航班上的座位上方行李艙塞得太滿了，我只好將隨身行李托運。

examples.en: My inbox is constantly stuffed with promotional emails and newsletters.
examples.zh: 我的電子信箱經常塞滿了促銷電子郵件和電子報。

examples.en: We felt completely stuffed after attending the corporate networking banquet.
examples.zh: 參加完企業聯誼宴會後，我們覺得肚子完全撐飽了。

examples.en: The charity organization is collecting new stuffed toys to give to children in the hospital.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構正在收集新的填充玩具，準備送給醫院裡的兒童。

examples.en: Our company decided to manufacture a limited edition plush toy as a promotional giveaway.
examples.zh: 我們公司決定生產一款限量版絨毛玩具作為促銷贈品。

examples.en: The retail store saw a significant increase in sales of plush toys during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 該零售店在假期間的絨毛玩具銷售量顯著增加。

examples.en: The recall was issued because a small part on the stuffed toy posed a choking hazard.
examples.zh: 由於填充玩具上的一個小零件有導致窒息的危險，因此發布了召回通知。

examples.en: Children who fly with our airline often receive a complimentary plush toy of our mascot.
examples.zh: 搭乘我們航空公司的兒童經常會收到我們吉祥物的免費絨毛玩具。

meaning: 令 N 羨慕 (嫉妒) 的對象

examples.en: Their state-of-the-art research facility has become the envy of competitors in the industry.
examples.zh: 他們最先進的研究設施已成為業界競爭對手羨慕的對象。

examples.en: After securing the exclusive contract, our sales team was the envy of the entire department.
examples.zh: 在取得獨家合約後，我們的銷售團隊成了全部門羨慕的對象。

examples.en: The company's generous employee benefits package makes it the envy of many startups.
examples.zh: 該公司優厚的員工福利方案使其成為許多新創公司羨慕的對象。

examples.en: With its rapid growth and high profit margins, the firm is the envy of Wall Street investors.
examples.zh: 憑藉其快速成長和高利潤率，該公司是華爾街投資者羨慕的對象。

examples.en: His seamless presentation skills are the envy of his colleagues who struggle with public speaking.
examples.zh: 他那流暢的簡報技巧讓那些害怕公開演講的同事們十分羨慕。

examples.en: All passengers must place their carry-on luggage on the conveyor belt for the x-ray machine.
examples.zh: 所有乘客必須將隨身行李放在輸送帶上通過X光機檢查。

examples.en: The clinic is upgrading its equipment to provide digital x-ray services for faster diagnosis.
examples.zh: 該診所正在升級設備，以提供數位X光服務，實現更快速的診斷。

examples.en: After the workplace accident, the employee was sent to the hospital for an immediate x-ray.
examples.zh: 發生工作場所意外後，該員工被送往醫院立即進行X光檢查。

examples.en: The security team discovered a prohibited item when they scanned the package with an x-ray.
examples.zh: 保全團隊用X光掃描包裹時發現了一件違禁品。

examples.en: The technician will need to x-ray the welded joints to ensure they meet safety standards.
examples.zh: 技術人員將需要用X光檢查焊接接頭，以確保其符合安全標準。
